scope: Read complete Japanese premise,11 turns,5 task hints and all12 locale sentence/task sets. No cross-worker semantic review.
reviewCriteria: Direction does not establish train final stop; Teine-ending service alone cannot reach Otaru. Preserve no-transfer preference and willingness to wait; rapid service stopping is unconfirmed until checked. Match destination,time,name on same board row and check same train at boarding platform before getting on.

Cosmetics: existing red cheeks means defer trying and buying, low-irritation label does not guarantee personal suitability. Shared ingredients do not establish cause; record labels, symptoms and usage dates for professional consultation before deciding on use.

Used washing machine: apparent installation width alone is insufficient; stairs, entrance turn and delivery route remain unchecked. Do not substitute incompatible parts; inspect hoses, taps and drain connection. No purchase or reservation is confirmed. Compare condition,accessories,operation,warranty,return terms and delivery costs after measuring.

Night-shift prescription: morning is an unresolved medication-specific timing question, not automatically waking time. Identify OTC product from box photo and disclose unconfirmed information before combinations. Write work/meals, use teach-back, ask how to seek advice for missed dose/shift changes. No independent dose or morning reinterpretation.

Beginner ski rental: equipment does not establish permission/ability for same terrain as skilled friend; instruction and participation conditions checked separately. Personal fit not friend equipment; pain and binding adjustment to staff. If participation guidance unavailable return to observing; booking and cancellation/return conditions precede commitment.

Tax records: annual deposits include two employers while paper covers current employer only after July switch. Business-trip reimbursement shares salary date but is not classified by date alone. Match employer/period,payslips,bank records,reimbursement copies; missing copy triggers employer inquiry,never guessed subtraction. Whether tax document correction needed remains consultation after facts confirmed.

Sightseeing boat: departure time was mistaken for return; request same boarding/return point and schedule margin. Friend personally checks seats/waiting and intermediate exit; departure/return may change and arbitrary disembarkation is not guaranteed. Buy only after explanation fits return plan; otherwise skip and return another day. Onboard illness contact remains staff question.
